summary.text: Christopher Mitchell is the American Constitution Party candidate for Colorado's 5th District and a repeat candidate for the seat. In a bio he submitted to KKTV in 2024, he described himself as an engineering contractor who grew up in Alamogordo, New Mexico.

paragraphs.text: In a 2024 bio submitted to KKTV, Mitchell listed his hometown as Alamogordo, New Mexico, and said he had lived in the 5th District for 24 years.
He listed a Bachelor of Science in Electrical and Computer Engineering from New Mexico State University, which Ballotpedia dates to 1994, and a profession of engineering contractor.
He was the American Constitution Party candidate for the 5th District in 2024 and reported no previously held elected positions.
